author: Bobby Grayson
description: Add MCP tools: start_session (creates a session + root goal node, returns session_id), end_session (closes session, generates summary). All add_node calls during a session auto-associate via session_nodes. The root goal captures the conversation's purpose. Each cowork/chat gets its own tree rooted at the session goal.
title: Session-scoped MCP: start_session/end_session tools + auto-root
